editorial:
Imagine finding your dream guy, only to realize he is actually a professional liar dating two other women at the same time. That is exactly what happens to Malu, Lucia, and Maria. These three women are all convinced that Samuel is the one, but when the truth comes out, their worlds collide in the funniest way possible. The movie has a bright, energetic vibe that feels like a wild girls' trip. You get to see three different personalities deal with the same heartbreak, and watching them go from rivals to best friends is the best part of the whole story.

The acting is great because the chemistry between the leads feels real and natural. While the plot is a bit predictable, the jokes land well and the pacing keeps you moving. If you are looking for something light to watch on a Friday night, this is it. It is a perfect choice for a movie night with friends who love stories about revenge and female friendship.
endingExplained: After the women stop fighting each other, they team up to give Samuel a taste of his own medicine. They set up a clever plan to humiliate him and show him that he cannot play people. In the end, Samuel loses everything because of his lies. The three women realize they are much better off without him. They walk away as strong, independent friends who found a real bond through a terrible breakup.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies and stories about revenge.
